claims.evidence: For fixed labels and orientations, the feasible set is compact. At a global minimum of the coordinate sum, every rectangle not on the left or top boundary has a touching blocker; otherwise a sufficiently small translation would reduce the objective. Blocker chains strictly decrease the relevant coordinate and terminate at the boundary, so every right and bottom edge is a nonnegative sum of 52 and 37. Exact semigroup enumeration gives maxima 1188 and 839 below the original dimensions.

claims.evidence: The explicit placement proves OPT≥516. The slack-residue contradiction excludes every 517-packing; any larger packing would contain a 517-sheet subpacking, so OPT≤516. These bounds coincide.
